cluster: C5 Client surfaces: categories, honest numbers, share (digests A5, R6, R12)

verdicts.recommendation: C5.1 Fragrance-only category chips, coming-soon chips, copy, coming_soon_tap event
verdicts.reason: The chip array, QUICK_CATS and copy keys exist as described, and adding an event to the allowlist is additive (the S80 scan_* entries set the precedent). But SMART_PICK_CATEGORY_KEYS only labels a server-sent pick. Trimming it hides the label, not the electronics pick, and reddens honestCopy.b3a r32, which is unnamed. A disabled TouchableOpacity never fires onPress, so the tap event cannot fire from a truly disabled chip.
evidence: SmartCompareApp/src/components/HomeEditorialSections.tsx:93-96 - SMART_PICK keys gate only the pill label
verdicts.fix: Keep SMART_PICK_CATEGORY_KEYS and filter non-fragrance smart picks and trending server-side behind the allowlist flag. Render coming-soon chips as enabled-but-inert (onPress fires the event plus a toast, accessibilityState disabled). Add honestCopy.b3a r32 to the pins to update.

verdicts.recommendation: C5.2 Remove CohortBadge, fabricated defaults; show thresholded real counts
verdicts.reason: The removals are correct: CohortBadge is mounted at ResultsContent:538 and ReferralLanding:223, LoadingRings defaults to 2074 at :129 and InviteeQuiz falls back to 78 at :169. But the pin list misses ResultsContent.render.test:213,250 (badge slot and mock render) and InviteeQuizScreen.matchScore.m18:165-167, which explicitly pins the 78 fallback. 'Seven orphan keys' does not match: only 3 keys carry 73% or {{count}}+, and 2 are still referenced. Compare and rater counts and price timestamps exist in no payload, so they need a dark backend field.
evidence: SmartCompareApp/__tests__/components/ResultsContent.render.test.tsx:213,250 - pins the cohort badge slot and render
app/models/product_schema.py:91,96 - only review_count exists; no price checked_at field
verdicts.fix: Do the removals as one OTA after approval and add the m18 and ResultsContent.render pins. Ship the replacement counts only after a dark ENABLE_* backend field carries compare_count, rater k/n and price_checked_at (build 3 ignores unknown fields), and render nothing until that field is present.

verdicts.recommendation: C5.3 Per-channel share builder, openURL fallback, fix text-only path
verdicts.reason: The message template, expo-clipboard and the canOpenURL gate are real, and openURL with a Share.share fallback works. But every target first POSTs createShare with a share_target that the Literal and the migration 014 CHECK limit to whatsapp|copy|x|telegram|snapchat|other, so SMS, Email and More cannot be recorded without a migration. The text-only path has no comparison_id, so it has no /c/ token to link, and APP_STORE_URL is empty.
evidence: SmartCompareApp/src/screens/ResultsScreen.tsx:532-546 - text-only path has no id, so no tokenised link exists
verdicts.fix: Map SMS, Email and More to share_target 'other' (or add a dark migration 045 plus a Literal widening first). In the text-only path link only the generic https://getmyez.com landing until ENABLE_COMPARISON_ID_ECHO is on after approval. Rewrite the Loop-2 reward block in the same OTA.

verdicts.recommendation: C5.4 Landing OG tags, assetlinks, dark /c/ preview route via nginx
verdicts.reason: index.html and ar/index.html already carry og:title/description/url and twitter:card; only og:image, the en locale and open.html are missing. The Dockerfile COPYs named files, so a new card image is not served unless added. Static nginx cannot read a backend flag. Proxying /c/ reddens test_landing_fallback_pages_s69:45 and the APP_STORE_URL pin :102. Reusing resolve_invite writes first_viewed_at, so a crawler unfurl would count as a view.
evidence: landing/Dockerfile:22-31 - explicit per-file COPY; landing/index.html:9-13 already has OG
verdicts.fix: Add only the missing og:image/locale tags plus a COPY line for the image. Gate the proxy with a landing-side env var rendered by envsubst, never the backend flag. Build the preview on a read-only lookup that requires ?ref, writes nothing and returns open.html bytes when the flag is off. Update the s69 nginx and APP_STORE_URL pins.

verdicts.recommendation: C5.5 Native 1.0.1 react-native-share, view-shot, Stories, Snap, metrics
verdicts.reason: Waiting for the 1.0.1 native build is correct (runtimeVersion appVersion, app.json:272-274). But share_target_opened is not in VALID_EVENT_TYPES. An Instagram target needs the 014 CHECK and the Literal widened. Snapchat Creative Kit is not part of react-native-share (it needs Snap's own SDK). /c/ visits are not logged anywhere: nginx serves static open.html, and first_viewed_at is only set when the app resolves the invite.
evidence: landing/nginx.conf.template:73-81 - /c/ /r/ /q/ served statically, no visit record
verdicts.fix: Before 1.0.1, add share_target_opened and share_channel_selected to the allowlist and a dark migration widening share_target. Plan the Snap Kit SDK separately. Measure conversion from referral_invites.first_viewed_at and redemption rows, with bot user-agents excluded, not from /c/ hits.

new_risks: The share sheet reward block promises the Loop-2 bonus (bonus comparisons for 7 days, up to the lifetime cap). That contradicts the single 3-per-day device quota, and shareTruth.s74 CT1/CT2 pin that copy. No recommendation re-scopes it or the usage_service referral bonus.

Fresh compares never get a comparison_id unless ENABLE_COMPARISON_ID_ECHO is on (text_routes.py:98), so the whole per-channel sheet is reachable only from History reopens. Flipping the flag changes what reviewers see, so it must be sequenced after approval and before the share OTA.

A /c/ preview proxied through nginx collapses every crawler to one rate-limit key while ENABLE_PROXY_AWARE_RATELIMIT is off (rate_limiter.py:53). The 20/min limit on the invite route would then throttle all link unfurls together.

The nginx comment (nginx.conf.template:61-66) records getmyez.com serving an unrelated page on 2026-10-10. Until DNS points at the landing service, the OG tags, AASA and open.html hand-off are invisible, and Universal Links cannot verify.
Server-sent smart pick, trending and History content can still show electronics and other categories after the chip trim. Nothing filters those feeds to fragrances.

The source_click event sends the full retailer URL (ResultsScreen.tsx:588), against the api.ts no-URL invariant. A new share_channel_selected or store_cta_tap event built the same way would leak query strings.
